scenario: [LEXP.8.8]: the bitwise and shift operators in a `const` fold ([LEXP.7.7], [LEXP.7.9], [LEXP.7.14.1]), and an `initial:` item may name one. Each `initial` fact carries one `Int` `const`'s folded value, and its rule compares that slot with the same `const` inlined and evaluated by the engine; the rule fires only if the two agree. `AND = 240 & 60`, `OR = 5 | 2`, `XOR = 6 ^ 3` and `NOT = ~0` are the bitwise operators; `SHL = 1 << 63` wraps to the most negative `Int`; `SHL64 = 1 << 64` is `0`, the count not reduced modulo 64; `SHR = -8 >> 1` is `-4`, the arithmetic shift; `SHR70 = -1 >> 70` is `-1`. Pin: all eight rules log, in source order. A compiler that does not fold these refuses the program with DS_VALIDATE_INITIAL_NOT_CONST. PATH PINNED: `dsc.dstest.ltsl_4_1_fold`'s `fold_int_binary` and `fold_unary`, against the rule's inlined `const` evaluated by each runtime's bitwise arm.
rules_ds:
const AND = 240 & 60
const OR = 5 | 2
const XOR = 6 ^ 3
const NOT = ~0
const SHL = 1 << 63
const SHL64 = 1 << 64
const SHR = -8 >> 1
const SHR70 = -1 >> 70

schema VI scope explicit:
    k: String
    i: Int

initial:
    VI k: "and" i: AND
    VI k: "or" i: OR
    VI k: "xor" i: XOR
    VI k: "not" i: NOT
    VI k: "shl" i: SHL
    VI k: "shl64" i: SHL64
    VI k: "shr" i: SHR
    VI k: "shr70" i: SHR70

rule r_and:
    VI v where v.k == "and" and v.i == AND
->
    log info "and"

rule r_or:
    VI v where v.k == "or" and v.i == OR
->
    log info "or"

rule r_xor:
    VI v where v.k == "xor" and v.i == XOR
->
    log info "xor"

rule r_not:
    VI v where v.k == "not" and v.i == NOT
->
    log info "not"

rule r_shl:
    VI v where v.k == "shl" and v.i == SHL
->
    log info "shl"

rule r_shl64:
    VI v where v.k == "shl64" and v.i == SHL64
->
    log info "shl64"

rule r_shr:
    VI v where v.k == "shr" and v.i == SHR
->
    log info "shr"

rule r_shr70:
    VI v where v.k == "shr70" and v.i == SHR70
->
    log info "shr70"
